name: SB-245570
summary: SB-245570 is a serotonin 5-HT1B receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder but was never marketed. It was being developed by GlaxoSmithKline in the 1990s. A chemical synthesis for SB-245570 has been published. The drug reached the preclinical research stage of development prior to the discontinuation of its development.

fact.en: Blocking 5-HT1B autoreceptors was meant to take the brakes off serotonin neurons and so make antidepressants act faster, but drugs built on this idea have not reached the clinic.
fact.zh: 阻斷 5-HT1B 自體受體的構想，是要鬆開血清素神經元的煞車，讓抗憂鬱藥更快起效，但基於這個想法的藥物都未進入臨床使用。
